fig2a_funnel.definition: Funnel steps: Tranco top-N; DNS-flagged (census buckets drawn in full + flagged in the random bucket); verified (drawn); live storefronts; sample; captured in all three base arms and analysed (sample minus the stores excluded after the crawl for content sensitivity minus the stores not captured). Creator stratum added separately.

fig1c_lead_ms.definition: Store S1152 Default load: banner-visible time minus first sandboxed request (and first sandboxed data beacon); requests after the 6 s axis crop (drawn as an edge count).

fig2b_worked_request.definition: First sandboxed data beacon carrying our test code in the Fig 1C load. Redaction rule for the figure: show host, path (account number masked), the carrier parameter and the decoded landing path + utm_* test code; drop all other parameter values (client IDs, hashes).

banner_default_partition.definition: Default-load banner stores split by Shopify's region default (allowed until choice / denied until consent / not readable), with the number whose sandboxed pixel sent an ad request before any choice.
banner_default_partition.check: allowed/denied equal fig3.d; totals equal fig1b.banner_fires

fig3c_timing_split.definition: Banner stores with a pre-choice sandboxed request (n = 205): gap = banner visible minus first sandboxed request; > one poll (250 ms) / 0 < gap <= 250 ms / gap <= 0.
fig3c_timing_split.check: first part == fig3.b.before_banner_by_poll; first two == fig3.b.before_banner

fig4a_routes.definition: Blocklist entries (vendor declared blocked before any choice) whose vendor has a configured sandboxed Shopify pixel on that store; fired in the Default load from a Shopify sandbox and, independently, from an ordinary page script (not hierarchical, unlike fig4c.csv outcome). primary_no_yes drops the 7 stores whose CMP wrote marketing: yes.

fig5b_exclusive_classes.definition: Stores with a residual sandboxed ad request, one class per store by hierarchy: (1) a pixel that declares the refused purpose kept sending (same page or unload; Decline only), else (2) a pixel declaring only purposes the choice left allowed, else (3) a pixel declaring no purpose, else other/unmatched. Decline: stores with a recorded refusal (any window after the click); GPC: stores where Shopify set sale of data: no.
fig5b_exclusive_classes.check: F3 and union equal composition.decline.classes; GPC left_allowed and any equal composition.gpc

fig5c_race_per_sandbox.definition: Third-party sandboxes declaring 'marketing' in loads where a CMP wrote marketing no (deny) or yes (grant) without a click; lag = sandbox start minus the consent event; axis clipped at -3 s / +1 s (edge counts).
